name: What should I prepare before contacting AKN Design Group about a guest house project?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting AKN Design Group about a guest house project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting AKN Design Group, it is helpful to have a general idea of your desired guest house's purpose, such as a multi-generational suite, home office, or rental unit, and any preliminary thoughts on size or style. Gathering information about your property's existing layout, potential build sites, and any known zoning restrictions can also streamline the initial consultation. While we manage the entire design-build process, having these details helps us better understand your vision and assess the project's scope. We will then guide you through the detailed planning stages, including design, budget, and permit coordination.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before contacting us, consider your guest house's purpose, desired size, and general style. Any information on your property's layout or zoning helps us assess the project scope.
